registry.label: Powder D50
registry.doc: Unknown for the Lithoz slurry. Published Cu VPP: 16 um (IFAM/Incus), 22 um (CEA-LITEN). 35 um pixels and 25 um layers need d90 < ~25 um. Drives permeability (d^2), native oxide (1/d), oxidation/reduction rates, sintering stress (1/d) and initial grain size. Measure: laser diffraction on powder recovered by solvent washing.

registry.label: PSD span (d90-d10)/d50
registry.doc: IFAM powder A: (25-9)/16 = 1.0. Sets the Sauter mean d32 used for surface-area terms. Measure: laser diffraction, in the same test as D50.

registry.label: Native oxide thickness
registry.doc: Gas-atomised Cu carries a 2-10 nm Cu2O film. Converts to initial oxygen via surface area. Measure: LECO O on recovered powder.

registry.label: Initial grain size / D50
registry.doc: Gas-atomised particles are polycrystalline; grains ~1/3-1/2 of particle size. Measure: EBSD on powder.

registry.label: Cu solids loading (vol)
registry.doc: Lithoz ceramics 39-49 vol%; Cu VPP 52-60 vol%. Measure: slurry pycnometry, phi = (rho - 1.13)/7.83.

registry.label: Binder density
registry.doc: Back-calculated two independent ways from Lithoz LithaLox HP500 and LithaNit 720 data.

registry.label: Non-reactive solvent (of binder)
registry.doc: Lithoz LCM organics contain a non-reactive solvent; its early evaporation opens the pore network that later pyrolysis gas escapes through. Measure: TGA mass loss below 250 C in N2.

registry.label: Binder removed by solvent debind
registry.doc: Fraction of binder extracted before the thermal cycle (IFAM/Incus: 24 h acetone). 0 for the Lithoz route, which has no solvent debind.

registry.label: Solvent TGA peak (10 K/min)
registry.doc: Resch reports a 70-140 C event; peak at 10 K/min placed at 170 C.

registry.label: Network pyrolysis peak (10 K/min, N2)
registry.doc: Acrylate networks (HDDA/TMPTA/urethane acrylates) scission at 380-430 C in N2 at 10 K/min. Measure: multi-rate TGA on cured green coupons.

registry.label: Char-forming residue peak (10 K/min)
registry.doc: Acrylate-bound Cu feedstocks lose weight to ~600 C in argon, leaving char.

registry.label: Network pyrolysis E
registry.doc: Isoconversional E for acrylate networks 150-240 kJ/mol.

registry.label: Backbone pyrolysis E
registry.doc: Low E makes this component broad, reproducing the slow tail to ~600 C.

registry.label: Backbone share of network
registry.doc: Fraction of non-solvent binder in the slow char-forming component.

registry.label: Char yield in inert gas
registry.doc: Roumanie (CEA): 0.394 wt% C after 400 C/4 h in Ar on a 60 vol% Cu part = ~5 % of the binder. Aromatic light-absorbing dyes (present in LCM slurries, absent from the CEA study) would raise it. Measure: LECO C on a coupon after 600 C in N2.

registry.label: Binder heat of combustion
registry.doc: Acrylates 24-28 MJ/kg. Heat released in the part follows Thornton's rule (13.1 MJ per kg O2). Measure: bomb calorimetry.

registry.label: Pyrolysis endotherm
registry.doc: Depolymerisation/volatilisation is mildly endothermic.

registry.label: Mean molar mass of volatiles
registry.doc: Sets moles of gas per kg of binder, hence internal pressure.

registry.label: Oxidative degradation shift
registry.doc: Polymers degrade oxidatively 50-100 K below their inert pyrolysis temperature in air.

registry.label: Oxidative degradation E
registry.doc: Thermo-oxidative degradation of acrylates has E ~80-140 kJ/mol, well below inert pyrolysis. Controls how fast a low-temperature air hold (IFAM: 63 h at 250 C) removes binder.

registry.label: Gas permeability of cured binder
registry.doc: Governs gas escape before the pore network percolates, which is where debinding cracks nucleate. Calibrate from the critical thickness in a thickness-ladder debind.

registry.label: Pore percolation threshold
registry.doc: Porosity at which binder removal opens a connected escape path.

registry.label: Green strength (RT)
registry.doc: IFAM LMM Cu: 20 (X;Z), 17 (Y;Z), 13 (Z;Y) MPa. Measure: 3-point bending of printed bars in the three build orientations.

registry.label: Interlayer strength factor
registry.doc: 13/20 from IFAM build-orientation data; applies to the build-direction (delamination) mode.

registry.label: Rubbery/glassy strength ratio
registry.doc: Strength retained above Tg.

registry.label: Green thermal conductivity
registry.doc: Polymer-continuous Maxwell-Eucken gives ~0.9; a percolating Cu skeleton could give 5-20. Decides whether oxidative debinding is heat-removal limited. Measure: laser flash on a cured coupon.

registry.label: Phosphorus retained
registry.doc: At 450 nm only BAPO-class (P-bearing) or acylgermane initiators are practical. 30-180 ppm if retained. Costs conductivity, not melting: P solubility in solid Cu is ~1.7 wt% at 714 C. Measure: ICP-OES on digested green body.

registry.label: P fraction in solid solution
registry.doc: Phosphate residues can stay as oxide unless strongly reduced.

registry.label: Critical half-thickness
registry.doc: Half of the thickest section (a 5 mm wall has 2.5 mm).

registry.label: Build-direction shrinkage anisotropy
registry.doc: Extra shrinkage in z from layered green structure (LCM ceramics: z 1-3 % larger).

registry.label: Total green volume in retort
registry.doc: Sets how much the load depletes or enriches the furnace gas.

registry.label: Convective h at the part
registry.doc: Retort with modest flow 5-20; a baffle and forced flow reach 50-150. Radiation is added separately.

registry.label: Air bleed into N2 available
registry.doc: A needle valve or MFC adding air to the N2 stream.

registry.label: Max H2 fraction
registry.doc: 0.04 = non-flammable forming gas (no hydrogen safety case). 1.0 = pure-H2 furnace.

registry.label: Max dew point
registry.doc: -40 = no humidifier; +20 = room-temperature bubbler; +60 = heated humidifier with heated line.

registry.label: O2 in 'inert' gas
registry.doc: 5.0-grade N2/Ar ~ 1-5 ppm; leaks add more.

registry.label: Load temperature uniformity (+/-)
registry.doc: Added to the melting margin. Measure by thermocouple survey.

registry.label: Char gasification half-life
registry.doc: At 800 C, dew point +20 C, 4 % H2. No rate constant exists for char on Cu in the literature. Measure: interrupted-quench LECO C series.

registry.label: Gasification E
registry.doc: Carbon-steam gasification 170-250 kJ/mol.

registry.label: Carbothermic reduction onset
registry.doc: Temperature at which Cu2O + C -> 2Cu + CO reaches 1e-4 1/s. Thermodynamically allowed above 76 C; kinetics unknown. A CO spike in the exhaust under inert gas identifies it.

registry.label: Cu2O reduction peak (TPR, 10 K/min, 4 % H2)
registry.doc: Consistent with native oxide reducing in minutes at 350 C (Ott).

registry.label: Char oxidation peak (air, 10 K/min)
registry.doc: Cu-catalysed char burns 400-550 C in air.

registry.label: Cu oxidation E
registry.doc: Fixed at a mid-literature value for Cu2O growth; prefactor and deceleration fitted to Ott (2022) powder data. See scripts/fit_cu_oxidation.py.

registry.label: Sintering viscosity factor
registry.doc: Multiplies the Coble + Nabarro-Herring viscosity from Frost & Ashby Cu diffusion data. Default fitted to CEA-LITEN DLP copper (22 um, 60 vol%, 1050 C/4 h H2 -> 90-94 %): 0.28 (0.22-0.34). The calibration knob for your powder, and no dilatometer is needed. Measure: caliper or Archimedes density of coupons pulled from 3-4 interrupted sinter runs, then refit with scripts/calibrate_sintering.py.

registry.label: Pore closure density
registry.doc: Scheibler: pores closed at 92-95 %.

registry.label: Carbon inhibition scale
registry.doc: Viscosity x (1 + (C/C_inh)^2). ~1550 ppm C held a Cu compact at ~59 % TD (US5302562A).

registry.label: Guard ramp while binder remains
registry.doc: Caps heating while >1 % of the binder remains, as a guard against failure modes the model does not contain (viscous slumping of the softened green body, capillary migration of liquid decomposition products, differential shrinkage). Once solvent evaporation has opened the pores the modelled gas pressure is slack, so without this guard the optimiser would pyrolyse at the furnace maximum. Relax it after a thickness-ladder debind shows parts survive faster ramps.

registry.label: Max oxide oxygen at pore closure

preset_docs.basic_tube: Tube furnace, N2 and 4 % forming gas only, no humidifier, no air bleed.
preset_docs.standard_retort: DEFAULT. Lab retort with N2, air-bleed MFC, 4 % forming gas (non-flammable, no H2 safety case) and a room-temperature water bubbler (dew point up to +20 C).
preset_docs.advanced_h2: Pure-H2-rated retort, heated humidifier (dew point to +60 C), baffle for forced convection.
